Maria L.: heads-up — evening wave at 18:30 PT. who is taking the 18:30 slot? need smoke owner + rollback readiness check :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jon: I can take 18:30. I'll be on-call and can run smoke. @Maria L. do we have the canary traffic split set?
Maria L.: thanks @Jon. canary 10% for 15m then 50% for 10m if green. fallback -> immediate 0% + rollback deployment.
Alex P.: quick FYI: there's one small PR (runtime/queue) still awaiting review from me, expect to merge by 17:50 PT. nothing blocking deploy but want to ensure no surprise schema changes.
Priya: db migration? the feature toggle depends on a tiny index addition. migration script is backward-compatible but takes ~30s on prod replica. recommend running migration during canary start.
Jon: good call. @Priya can you post the migration command? I'll run it and watch metrics.
Priya: sure — run on primary-read: ```psql -c "ALTER TABLE requests ADD INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_req_created_at (created_at);"``` will be a fast op. monitor replica lag.
DeployBot: [pipeline] deploy/redwood-service #287 scheduled by Jon at 2024-10-31T18:30:00Z — https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/287
Maria L.: plan: 17:50 merge -> 18:05 start preflight smoke on staging -> 18:15 run migration -> 18:20 kick canary (10% for 15m) -> 18:35 eval -> 18:45 ramp 50% for 10m -> final ramp. rollback window 18:20-18:40 if errors.
Jon: I'll run the staging smoke checklist and paste results. minimal acceptance: 95% success on critical routes, latency p50 < 120ms.
Alex P.: I'll keep an eye on logs and be ready to revert my change if we see any queue errors.
Priya: I'll monitor replica lag and DB error logs. I can also toggle feature flag if needed.
Jon: staging smoke done: all green except one 500 on /embed which looks flaky (not related).
Maria L.: noted. thanks. last call: anyone can't make it?
Alex P.: I'm available remotely.
Priya: available.
Jon: all set. starting merge at 17:50. :thumbsup:
Maria L.: thanks team — ping this thread after deploy complete and when rollback toggles happen. :rocket:
